MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 2/2
   C. They are equal
   D. Cannot tell

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 21
   C. 42
   D. 90

3. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 13
   C. 170
   D. 26

4. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31
   C. 31.7
   D. 37

5. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 16
   C. 4
   D. 5

6. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 144
   C. 156
   D. 48

7. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

8. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 34
   B. 66
   C. 22
   D. 17

9. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.6
   C. 27.7
   D. 27

10. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 12x + 2

11. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 14
   C. 48
   D. 49

12. Solve for x: x + 8 = 18. (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 8
   C. 10
   D. 18

13. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 12
   C. 13
   D. 1

14. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 10

15. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.7
   C. 21
   D. 15.6

16. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 49
   C. 7
   D. 50

17. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 18

18. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 13
   C. 36
   D. 37

19. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 10

20. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 21
   C. 15
   D. 3

21. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19
   C. 19.7
   D. 19.6

22. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 49

23. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

24. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 16
   C. 65
   D. 64

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

26. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
